R8504.summary: A short clear holograph note from Stafford; the only cipher is one seven-sign word on line 2, 'princes', read with the Walsingham letter key rebuilt in harley1582r8500.

snip.cap: Harley MS 1582 f. 76r: the one cipher word, princes
snip.credit: British Library, Harley MS 1582 f. 76r, via DECODE R8504

system: Letter substitution with homophones (6=e, w=a, x=i/y ...) plus single-sign and numeric codes (B Villeroy, O+ Nemours, 120 French ambassador, 47 King of Navarre).
